model.note: Google's TTS page (read via Muse, 2026-10-27) documents the Gemini 3.8 models as the current ones: 3.8 Flash for studio-grade narration and stable long-form voice, 3.8 Flash-Lite as the cheap high-volume option, and 3.1 Flash Preview as the older model. style: Authoritative, calm financial advisor delivery with a warm, confident tone, steady downward inflections, and clear, measured pacing.
styleRules: Keep the style string identical for every request of an episode (and across episodes).
The text field is spoken verbatim: no stage directions in it.
Only <short pause> and <long pause> inline tags; sound effects come from the sound plan, not the voice.
Never ask the model to 'keep the voice steady' (documented to increase drift).
Do not put age, gender or accent changes in style; choose a different library voice instead.

styleVariants.user: Authoritative, calm financial advisor delivery with a warm, confident tone, steady downward inflections, and clear, measured pacing.

request.variantNote: Owner picked 'user' (the exact style line above) on 2026-10-27 after hearing all three on the same sentence. Google's own guidance was to prefer empty/short over a long style string since longer style text is documented to increase drift; the owner's choice overrides that default, so every production TTS call for this channel uses the full 'user' style string, not 'empty' or 'short'. Re-audition if drift becomes visible across a full episode.
request.emphasis: capitalise a word for vocal stress
